**A complete, ground-up dark-mode rework.** v2.0 replaces the partial v1.x theme with a
clean, sleek, **fully dark UI** — a monochrome IBM&nbsp;Carbon `#161616` across the *entire*
JDownloader interface (download list, link grabber **and** settings, not just the menu bar),
in a borderless, maximised kiosk window. It just looks great from the first start, with zero
setup.

> ### ⏳ First start — wait for the READY banner
> On the **first start (and after every image update)** JDownloader installs/updates itself
> and applies the dark theme, so the WebUI stays **black for a few minutes**. Watch the
> container **log** and open the WebUI only once you see:
> ```text
> ############################################################
>  JDOWNLOADER IS READY  ->  open the WebUI now (HTTPS 3001)
> ############################################################
> ```
> **Don't restart the container during the install.** It self-heals JDownloader's first-run
> theme reset and prints the banner **only when the UI is up _and_ fully dark** — so when you
> see it, it's already dark and ready.

## Highlights

- 🌑 **Clean, sleek, complete Dark Mode** — monochrome IBM Carbon `#161616` across the *whole*
  GUI (content too, not just the menu bar), in a borderless maximised window. Switch to a
  matching Light theme any time with the `JD_THEME` variable.
- 🟩 Progress bars with **light fills and readable text**; the speed-meter graph stays green.
- 🧊 A genuinely **turnkey** experience: auto-install, auto-confirmed install prompts, and the
  theme **self-heals** after JDownloader's own updates.

## Added

- **Native, race-free dark theme** — JDownloader's own `colorfor*` palette (Carbon `#161616`)
  for all content areas, a **patched FlatLaf** (`flatlaf.jar`) for the window chrome, and the
  bundled **flat icon set** — re-applied on every launch.
- **Theme auto-heal** — JDownloader resets its theme when it self-installs/updates; the
  container detects this and restarts JD once so the full dark theme is re-applied
  automatically (bounded, no restart loops).
- **`JDOWNLOADER IS READY` log banner** — printed **only** when JD is up *and* the dark theme
  is applied, so it never appears while the UI is still rendering.
- **Column-layout persistence** — hidden columns, sort order and widths now survive a
  `docker restart`/stop (graceful JVM shutdown so JD can flush its settings).
- **Auto-confirmed install dialogs** — a tiny `-javaagent` clicks JDownloader's forced
  first-run install prompts for you; nothing to click.
- **HTTPS WebUI by default** (port `3001`) for **seamless browser clipboard**, plus a proper
  browser-tab favicon.
- **Kiosk window** — borderless, maximised JD window; dialogs (e.g. *Add premium account*)
  float at their natural size instead of being maximised.

## Changed

- Dark mode reworked from the v1.x approach to JD's native `colorfor*` + a patched
  `flatlaf.jar` — **no** fragile runtime colour agent and **no** boot-classpath NPE.
- Download list: **uniform rows** (no alternating stripes), darkening only on mouse-over.
- The LinuxServer base-image branding / donate line is removed from the init log, so only
  this image's banner shows.

## Fixed

- **JDownloader now launches reliably.** A SIGHUP from `openbox-autostart` could kill the
  launcher before the JVM started, leaving the WebUI black — the launcher no longer traps it.
- **Account-Manager traffic bar** no longer flickers to an unreadable light-on-light state.
- **Hidden columns** no longer reappear after a container restart.
- Removed the window title bar (kiosk); File/Settings/Extras menus no longer close on
  mouse-release under KasmVNC.

## Notes

- First start can take a few minutes (JDownloader installs itself) — see the READY banner box
  above.
- All settings, links and session state live in `/config` and survive every image update.
